# Generic example: shift an alarm by a given number of minutes and disable others
def shift_alarm_and_disable_others(label_substring, shift_minutes, access_token):
    target = find_one_from_pages(
        apis.phone.show_alarms,
        access_token=access_token,
        find_by={"label__has_substring": label_substring},
    )
    new_time = Time.from_string(target.time).add(minutes=shift_minutes).to_string()
    apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=target.alarm_id, time=new_time, access_token=access_token)
    for alarm in find_all_from_pages(apis.phone.show_alarms, access_token=access_token):
        if alarm.alarm_id != target.alarm_id and alarm.enabled:
            apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=alarm.alarm_id, enabled=False, access_token=access_token)
